hits.title: Changelog - Product Updates | Superagent
hits.snippet: August 15, 2026 ## Context Guardrails for everything agents consume Score web pages, email, files, agent skills, and public GitHub MCP repositories before an agent trusts them. Runtime Guardrails decide what an agent may do. Context Guardrails decide what an agent may consume. Agents fetch pages, open files, install skills, and connect MCP servers without reviewing any of it. Superagent now scores that untrusted context first, so agents keep full capability without inheriting hostile input. ### Five origins, available now - **Web pages**— domain identity, redirect chains, hidden DOM, and rendered page text. New lookups return a preliminary identity score immediately and finish the deep scan in the background. - **Email**— sender authentication, phishing and injection patterns, attachments, and outbound links. - **Files**— public text and PDFs, with type consistency, encoded instructions, and prompt injection checks. File bytes are never stored. - **Agent skills**— GitHub publisher identity, requested capabilities, hidden instructions, and install hooks. Skill files are treated as untrusted data and are never executed. - **MCP repositories**— static review of public GitHub MCP serve
